Sky & Telescope's Pocket Sky Atlas

The whole sky in your coat pocket — 30,796 stars, zero batteries.

around $30

The most recommended star atlas in the hobby: 30,796 stars down to magnitude 7.6 across 80 charts, compact enough to take anywhere. Never needs charging, never crashes, works at every dark site.

Why we like it

  • 80 charts with 30,796 stars — deep enough for a telescope
  • Pocket-size, dews up less than big atlases
  • The standard reference every observer recognizes

Keep in mind

  • Print is small — bring a red flashlight and readers
  • Pages stick together in heavy dew
  • Jumbo edition exists if the pocket print is too small
